questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that contains a grammatical error in the underlined portion.**

I had take a vow of celibacy which was a part of my training while I was in the temple.

options.text: __I had take a vow of celibacy__ which was a part of my training while I was in the temple.
I had take a vow of celibacy which was a part of my training __while I was in the temple.__
I had take a vow of celibacy which was a part __of my training__ while I was in the temple.
I had take a vow of celibacy __which was a part__ of my training while I was in the temple.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"__I had take a vow of celibacy__ which was a part of my training while I was in the temple."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**** **

__
 
• In the sentence **"I had take a vow of celibacy which was a part of my training while I was in the temple," **the grammatical error lies in the phrase **"I had take a vow of celibacy."**
 
• This sentence uses the **past perfect tense **incorrectly.
 
• The past perfect tense is used to express that an action took place and was completed in the past before another past action.
 
• In the past perfect tense, we use **"had" **followed by the **past participle of the main verb.**
 
• In the given sentence, **"take" **is incorrectly used as the past participle of the main verb **"take". **
 
• The correct past participle of **"take" **is **"taken". **
 
• The corrected phrase should be **"I had taken a vow of celibacy..."**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

 

**Correct sentence**: *"I had taken a vow of celibacy __*which was a part of my training while I was in the temple."

• **Endangered: **to cause danger to somebody/something. ((व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को) ख़तरे में डालना)
 
• **Confiscated: **to take something away from somebody as a punishment. (दंडस्‍वरूप कोई वस्‍तु ज़ब्‍त कर लेना)
 
• **Banned: **to officially say that something is not allowed, often by law. (प्रायः क़ानूनी तौर पर प्रतिबंध या रोक लगाना; आधिकारिक)
